data.title: Robotic Wolf: China Unveils New AS2-W UGV
data.description: The Chinese robotics company Unitree has unveiled its new Super Athlete AS2-W UGV.The product is showcased on the manufacturer’s website.The UGV can travel approximately 30 km on a single battery […]
